stylePrefix: 8-bit / 16-bit video-game character of the person in the reference image. Render seams, clothing detail, facial features, and facial expression in that stylization. Readable face and outfit. Not photorealistic, not smooth 3D, not soft airbrush, not painterly gradients, not tiny emoji blob, not UI glass stair-step SVG style. Isolated character only on flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF. No room, no environment, no floor plate, no rectangular photo matte.

stages.profile: Create a right-side torso profile of the person in the source image as an 8-bit/16-bit video-game character. Bust from head through upper chest. Keep likeness. Full figure not required. Not head-on. Not seated bar pose. Not full-body walk.
stages.sit: TWO REFERENCES IN ORDER: (1) CHARACTER PROFILE — face, hair, clothing, identity; this person must appear. (2) SIT MESH TEMPLATE — single black silhouette head-on seated bust with skeleton joints; this is the ONLY source of pose and camera framing. OUTPUT: the PROFILE person as a CENTERED FRONT HEAD-ON seated bust (facing camera) in a leaning-on-bar pose: head to mid-torso, arms resting forward as if on a bar top. Large readable face. STRICTLY do NOT render any bar, bar top, table, counter, furniture, or surface under the arms — pose only, character floating on solid #FF00FF with empty space where a bar would be. Keep PROFILE likeness and outfit. Copy the TEMPLATE's head-on seated framing and arm pose. DO NOT copy template colors: no black silhouette fill, no tan background, no yellow joint dots, no green bone lines. HARD NEGATIVES: no side profile, no three-quarter profile, no full body, no legs, no standing pose, no bar props. Not a recolored side profile of the first reference.
stages.talk: Keep this EXACT sit pose, framing, clothing, lighting language, and pixel style identical. Only change the mouth to clearly OPEN for talking (visible mouth cavity / open lips). Same head-on seated bust. Do not change pose, angle, or background. Do not smile closed-mouth. Mouth must be open.
stages.walkSheet: TWO REFERENCES IN ORDER: (1) CHARACTER PROFILE — face, hair, clothing, identity; this person must appear in every cell. (2) WALK MESH TEMPLATE — horizontal sheet of black silhouette figures with skeleton joints; the ONLY source of limb pose and gait. The template shows TRUE ALTERNATING opposite strides: cells alternate between pose A and pose B (A = one leg forward with opposite arm back; B = the other leg forward with arms swapped). OUTPUT: one horizontal 4-up sheet of the PROFILE character as full-body RIGHT-PROFILE 8-bit/16-bit character sprites on flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF. Keep the PROFILE person's likeness and outfit. Copy the TEMPLATE's limb configurations exactly left-to-right (cell1=template figure1, cell2=figure2, cell3=figure3, cell4=figure4) so consecutive cells alternate A/B strides — NOT four identical mid-strides. Same height, scale, shared foot baseline. DO NOT copy template colors: no black silhouette fill, no tan background, no yellow joint dots, no green bone lines. DO NOT invent a different person or freeform poses. HARD NEGATIVES: no jump, leap, airborne, high kick, dance, crossed arms idle, run-leap, action-pose, both feet off ground, four clone poses. Grounded alternating walk only.

walkSplit.01: Extract ONLY the LEFTMOST / first cell of the reference walk sheet (template phase 1 / CONTACT) as one full-body right-profile sprite on flat #FF00FF. Same character identity, clothing, height, and baseline as that cell. STRICT extract only — do not re-pose, re-scale, or invent a new stance. Grounded walk; no jump, leap, airborne, kick, dance, or crossed arms.
